description: Site lifecycle operations: list; bind_api_token with site, entry_name, expected_version and optional set_default; set_default with site/expected_version; disconnect with site/expected_version. Every verb accepts site. Disconnect removes local credentials, not the vendor token. Native vault auditing records stores/rotations/deletes; secret history is not returned. history reads non-secret append-only binding events. Failed post-unbind cleanup is visible in credential_cleanup_pending and can be resumed by disconnect at the new version.
embedding_description: Connect several Jira Cloud sites with separate vaulted credentials, list and correct bindings, choose a default and disconnect a site. API-token bindings copy a vault-referenced address-book entry. Version checks prevent stale binding changes; the original legacy site remains available.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Site index/default/version, consent URL, or pending status. No tokens or client secrets.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Report the selected site and binding outcome. A consent URL means pending consent, not connected.

error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: stale_binding requires a fresh index version; oauth_state requires fresh consent; oauth_resources means the site is not granted; vault_error means persistence failed.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Read current site state, correct configuration, or restart consent as indicated. Never expose credentials.
